## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick the cylindrical can with smooth surface and the red can simultaneously, then place both in the portable light blue storage plasticbox.

Task description: Pick up both the red-yellow-green cylindrical can to the left of the storage box and the red can on the right, and put them into the light blue portable plastic storage box in the center.

Success criteria: Both cans must be inside the light blue storage box, each horizontally near either of its two placement targets. Both grippers must be open and release the cans.

## Execution tips

- Grasp straight middle can sidewalls with opposing pad contact, avoiding rolled top and bottom rims. Open slightly wider than the can diameter to reduce sweeping contact during approach.
- Before closing, verify that the two fingers are actually on opposite sides of the can body, rather than merely overlapping in the image. Lift both sides together only after establishing a secure grip to reduce slipping on the smooth can or missing one side.
- When moving toward the box opening, keep the jar bottoms and lower edges of the grippers above the rim, and leave clearance between both jars and both grippers to avoid colliding with each other or shifting the storage box as they come together.
- During lowering, keep the can bottom downward and leave room to open the fingers between its body and the box wall. Release once the bottom is supported to reduce tipping or moving the can or lightweight box during withdrawal.
